clinic.heroSubtitle: At Grand Dental - Naperville, we specialize in permanent solutions for missing or failing teeth, offering advanced dental implant procedures that restore the look, feel, and function of natural teeth. With our in-house periodontist and flexible financing, we make achieving a confident, healthy smile accessible for adults facing tooth loss.

differentiators.title: In-House Periodontist
differentiators.description: Benefit from specialized gum treatments and dental implant procedures performed by our expert periodontist on-site, saving you time and money.

differentiators.title: State-of-the-Art Technology
differentiators.description: Experience superior care with advanced dental technology, including CT scanners and lasers, for precise diagnostics and effective treatment.

differentiators.title: Flexible Financial Solutions
differentiators.description: Access comprehensive dental implant care through in-network insurance savings, an in-house membership plan, and flexible financing options.

differentiators.title: Patient-Centered Experience
differentiators.description: Enjoy transparent treatment plans, comfortable sedation options, and convenient scheduling that prioritizes your comfort and understanding.

treatmentJourney.title: Initial Consultation & Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough consultation, including 3D scans and advanced diagnostics, to develop a personalized treatment plan for your dental implants.

treatmentJourney.title: Preparation & Foundation Work
treatmentJourney.description: Any necessary preparatory procedures, such as extractions, bone grafting, or gum care, will be completed to create a healthy foundation for your implants.

treatmentJourney.title: Implant Surgical Placement
treatmentJourney.description: Our in-house periodontist will precisely place the titanium dental implant into your jawbone, ensuring optimal positioning and stability for long-term success.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing & Osseointegration
treatmentJourney.description: A healing period of several months allows the implant to fuse with your jawbone, a critical process known as osseointegration, creating a strong anchor for your new tooth.

treatmentJourney.title: Abutment & Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: Once healed, an abutment is attached to the implant, and final impressions are taken to custom-craft your permanent crown, bridge, or full arch restoration.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Restoration & Care
treatmentJourney.description: Your custom-made crown, bridge, or arch is securely attached, completing your smile. We then establish a long-term care plan to maintain your beautiful, functional implants.

implantOptions.title: Single Tooth Implants
implantOptions.description: Replace one missing tooth with a durable implant and natural-looking crown.

implantOptions.title: Multiple Tooth Implants
implantOptions.description: Restore several missing teeth with strategically placed implants for a secure, long-lasting solution.

implantOptions.title: Implant-Supported Bridges

implantOptions.description: Secure dentures to dental implants for improved comfort, stability, and chewing function.

faqItems.question: How long does the dental implant process take?
faqItems.answer: The duration of the dental implant process can vary, as it involves several stages from initial consultation and placement to healing and final restoration. Our team will provide a detailed timeline based on your specific needs during your consultation.

faqItems.question: How much do dental implants cost, and what are my financing options?
faqItems.answer: The cost of dental implants varies depending on your specific needs. We offer transparent pricing, accept various in-network PPO insurance plans like Aetna and Cigna, provide an in-house membership plan (Grand Advantage Plan), and flexible financing to make treatment affordable.

faqItems.question: Am I a candidate for dental implants if I have bone loss or gum disease?
faqItems.answer: Our in-house periodontist, Dr. John Micaletti, specializes in addressing complex cases like bone loss and gum disease. We will assess your oral health to determine if you are a suitable candidate and discuss any necessary preparatory treatments.

faqItems.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqItems.answer: With proper care and maintenance, dental implants are designed to be a long-term solution, often lasting many decades or even a lifetime. We will guide you through a long-term care plan to ensure their longevity.

faqItems.question: Is implant surgery painful, and what sedation do you offer?
faqItems.answer: We prioritize your comfort and offer sedation dentistry options, including nitrous oxide and IV sedation, to ensure a pain-free and relaxing experience during your dental implant procedure. Our team will discuss the best option for you.

faqItems.question: Where is your Naperville office located?
faqItems.answer: Our Naperville dental office is conveniently located at 4425 Montgomery Road, Ste. 101, just off Highway 59. We are close to Springbrook Golf Course, NailBar Studio, West Naperville KinderCare, and U.S. Bank Branch, and happy to assist with directions if needed.

doctor.name: Dr. John Micaletti
doctor.bio: Dr. John Micaletti is a highly experienced periodontist at Grand Dental – Naperville, specializing in advanced gum treatments and dental implant procedures. His expertise ensures patients receive comprehensive care for missing teeth and periodontal disease, often preventing the need for external referrals. Dr. Micaletti is dedicated to improving both the health and beauty of his patients' smiles, leveraging his specialized knowledge to achieve lasting results.
